title: Code, Commits, and Complexity in the GenAI Era: A Longitudinal Study of Team-Based Capstone Projects
abstract: arXiv:2611.07297v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI tools are now widely available to students, but little is known about how team-based project codebases have changed since they appeared. This matters when project courses use repository activity as evidence of progress and learning. Existing studies have largely examined self-reports, controlled tasks, or short individual assignments, leaving open questions around how student codebases evolve in authentic project settings. We present a ten-semester analysis of N=260 capstone team repositories from 2021 to 2025, spanning pre- and post-AI cohorts. We examine three dimensions: code size (lines of code), code characteristics (comment density, error-handling density, and cyclomatic complexity), and development behaviour (commit volume, edit size, and commit frequency). translated_title: 生成式AI时代的代码、提交与复杂度：基于团队毕业设计项目的纵向研究
translated_abstract: 生成式AI工具如今已广泛供学生使用，但关于团队项目代码库自其出现以来发生了怎样的变化，人们知之甚少。当项目式课程将代码仓库活动作为学习进展的证据时，这一点尤为重要。现有研究大多考察的是自我报告、受控任务或简短的个人作业，学生代码库在真实项目环境中如何演变仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们对2021年至2025年间N=260个毕业设计团队代码仓库进行了为期十个学期的分析，涵盖了AI出现前后的不同群体。我们从三个维度进行考察：代码规模（代码行数）、代码特征（注释密度、错误处理密度和圈复杂度）以及开发行为（提交量、编辑大小和提交频率）。我们发现，学期末的代码库规模增长约三倍，从2021-2023年的约3.4千行代码增长到2024-2025年的约10千行代码。代码特征显示出明显的解耦……
tldr: 该研究对2021-2025年间260个毕业设计团队代码仓库进行了十个学期的纵向分析，发现生成式AI工具出现后学生团队项目代码库规模增长约三倍，揭示了真实项目环境中学生开发行为与代码特征的显著变化。
en_tdlr: This longitudinal study of 260 capstone team repositories across ten semesters (2021–2025) reveals that student team project codebases roughly tripled in size after the emergence of generative AI tools, uncovering significant changes in student development behavior and code characteristics in authentic project settings.
